content:
rhea: quick sync  we did an int6 bringup for sparrow-lite-emb-v2 on staging. baseline fp32 recall@1/5/10 (webq): 0.601/0.742/0.841. int6 per-tensor w/ asymmetric zp crushed recall@1 -> 0.512. short-tail subset (queries <=6 tokens) shows recall@1 drop to 0.38. screenshots + logs: https://artifacts.internal/sparrow-lite-v2/5522

tom: ouch. good catch. is this per-tensor or per-channel? any post-quant norm?

rhea: per-tensor asymmetric, no post-reprojection. decoding pipeline is the usual: `dequant(q) -> l2norm -> index_search` but l2norm applied after decode only.

ivy: per-tensor can smear scaling across dims for embeddings. try per-channel symmetric (no zp) and optionally add bias-correction after quant (mean-shift). also test cosine vs inner product indexes.

rhea: started a run: per-channel symmetric + mean-bias-corr + L2, k=10 eval on short/full. eval command: `./ci/run_embed_eval.sh --model sparrow-lite-emb-v2 --quant int6pc --holdout short,full`

samar: any cluster metrics? if neighborhoods break, NMI vs topical labels should drop.

metric-bot: eval job 5522334470 complete:
- per-tensor asym int6: recall@1/5/10 full = 0.512/0.693/0.781; short = 0.382/0.521/0.623
- per-channel sym int6 + mean-corr: recall@1/5/10 full = 0.588/0.724/0.833; short = 0.548/0.69/0.78
- silhouette full: fp32 0.44 -> int6pc 0.4; short holdout silhouette: 0.37 -> 0.35
- P95 latency: +3%
links: https://dash.internal/evals/5522334470

tom: that recovers most of the gap, nice. short still down ~6-7% vs fp32 for recall@1 but much closer. noise might be from token-weighting. did you try reweighting anchor pooling (CLS vs mean)?

rhea: current model pools token mean. will try CLS pooling + small distillation (50k pairs) for short queries. also scheduling a PQ fallback for the 5% canary on production if recall < threshold.

ivy: for the distill, use margin-based loss on shortest queries only. tiny retrain for 1 epoch on 50k pairs usually stabilizes nearest neighbors. track recall@1/5 and knn-precision@10.

bert-bot: started training job: tiny-distill-5522334501 (50k pairs) - link: https://ml.internal/job/td-5522

metric-bot: tiny-distill job finished: delta vs per-channel-int6:
- recall@1 short: 0.615 (fp32 short 0.649)
- recall@5 short: 0.73
- knn-precision@10 short: 0.67 (improved from 0.61)
notes: silhouette up to 0.38, latency +3.5%

samar: that looks promising. propose rollout: 3-phase canary: (1) engineering staging 10% traffic, (2) prod canary 2% for 24h with snapshot evals every 15m, (3) 25% with automatic rollback if short recall@1 drops >4% relative to baseline.

rhea: adding followup checks: NMI, cluster purity, recall-variant by query-length buckets, and false-positive rate on duplicates. will author the canary YAML and PR tonight.

tom: please tag me when PR's up, I'll check the dashboards and set alerts. thanks all. :thumbsup:
